scenarios.does_NOT_prove: anything about sanctions screening -- CTL-PLACEHOLDER-SANCTIONS-SCREENING is a stand-in (True)

scenarios.title: AIRA proposes a $250,000.00 action
scenarios.proves: CompliIdentity reports approval_required:true at exactly the $250,000.00 threshold; CompliAGL's DC-HARBORSTONE-HUMAN-APPROVAL condition turns that into ESCALATED / HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED. The assessment is SATISFIED, so the escalation comes from the authority-context wiring, not an evidence gap
scenarios.does_NOT_prove: that real sanctions screening passed -- CTL-PLACEHOLDER-SANCTIONS-SCREENING is a stand-in (True)

no_execution_authorization.message: Execution authorization can only be issued for an APPROVED decision (decision 1e011296-8b7f-4047-9529-cb164c79c6a8 is ESCALATED).

scenarios.title: Jordan approves the escalated decision; CompliAGL re-evaluates to APPROVED, first decision preserved
scenarios.proves: escalation_approval_service.submit() verifies Jordan's authority to approve LIVE against CompliIdentity (real aml.action:approve probe -> sufficient:true, HUMAN principal, matching Decision.required_approver_types distilled from CompliIdentity's own applicable_approvals on AIRA's probe); then decide_for_resolution(prior_decision_id=) upgrades the escalation via DC-HARBORSTONE-APPROVED-VIA-HUMAN. The prior ESCALATED decision is preserved + SUPERSEDED, a NEW APPROVED decision is created, the approval is CONSUMED, and only then does an ExecutionAuthorization issue.
scenarios.does_NOT_prove: that real sanctions screening passed -- CTL-PLACEHOLDER-SANCTIONS-SCREENING is a stand-in (True)
